key_highlights: ASX set to open higher following a Wall Street rally, despite steep declines in Nvidia linked to a foreign intelligence probe.
ANZ reports robust FY cash profit of $7.6b, though emerging signs of mortgage stress and rising 90+ day arrears warrant caution.
Commodity headwinds persist as crude oil dips and iron ore faces demand softness, offset by local exploration wins in gold and critical minerals.
Domestic macro pressures escalate with Australia recording severe housing price pullbacks and contractor insolvencies.

sectors.trend: Solid headline earnings contrasted by rising mortgage delinquency rates and broader housing market downturn.
sectors.implications: Banks face elevated provisioning and slower credit growth; capital strength remains a defensive pillar.

sectors.trend: Iron ore prices under pressure amid macro uncertainty, while junior gold and critical minerals report resource growth.
sectors.implications: Favour low-cost iron ore majors with AUD currency tailwinds; tactical upside in gold explorers.

sectors.trend: Crude oil weakness weighs on sentiment; gas sector sees long-term licensing milestones alongside native title scrutiny.
sectors.implications: Near-term cash flow compression for major LNG producers; heightened ESG and regulatory compliance oversight.

sectors.trend: Global spillover from Nvidia probe dampens tech sentiment, while local data centre expansion addresses grid bottlenecks.
sectors.implications: Multiple contraction in high-valuation tech; defensive positioning around mission-critical digital infrastructure.

sectors.trend: Large-scale contractor insolvencies and house price declines intensify sector distress.
sectors.implications: Heightened credit default risk and supply delays across residential and commercial developments.

key_themes: Wall Street decoupling: Broader US equity strength overcoming idiosyncratic mega-cap tech sell-offs.
Domestic credit strain: RBA restrictive policy transmission manifesting in rising loan arrears and housing price weakness.
Currency insulation: Depreciating AUD/USD cushioning Aussie commodity exporters against global price declines.

risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight regional mortgage lenders; focus on major banks with superior liquidity and conservative LTV profiles.
Prioritise lowest-quartile cost producers such as BHP and hedge with gold exposure.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Tech Geopolitical and Supply Chain Shocks
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce exposure to speculative growth tech; rotate toward infrastructure and utility-like tech assets.
Avoid REITs with high developer exposure or unhedged turnkey contract structures.

opportunities.recommendation: Accumulate diversified low-cost resources with AUD FX leverage
opportunities.rationale: Weakening AUD offsets softening commodity prices, protecting free cash flow and dividend yields.

opportunities.recommendation: Selective exposure to digital infrastructure and data centre operators
opportunities.rationale: Structural demand remains robust as operators work through power grid connectivity hurdles.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge broad index exposure against mortgage credit contagion
defensive_moves.rationale: Sustained household debt servicing pressures threaten domestic bank valuations and retail consumption.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Underweight high-beta energy equities amid global crude weakness
defensive_moves.rationale: Lingering downward pressure on oil prices and project approval friction constrain near-term earnings.

market_outlook.short_term: Rangebound ASX 200 trading with upward support from US equity momentum constrained by local credit and commodity headwinds.
market_outlook.long_term: Defensive quality and cash-flow generative resources will outperform as Australian monetary policy reaches its terminal cycle.
key_catalysts: RBA monetary policy statements and commentary on household debt stress
Nvidia intelligence investigation outcomes and US chip export policy clarity
Chinese industrial stimulus updates affecting bulk commodity demand
Upcoming domestic banking earnings updates and loan loss provisioning metrics
watch_list: Iron ore 62% Fe CFR Qingdao benchmark and Brent crude price movements
Australian 90+ day mortgage delinquency ratios and auction clearance rates
ASIC insolvency notices in the commercial construction sector
